items.name: Powdered sugar or cinnamon sugar dust

steps.title: Prepare Dough & Shape Uniformly
steps.instructionTemplate: Combine {eu65_flr}, {eu65_mlk}, and {eu65_but} into a smooth elastic dough or batter. Shape evenly and rest 15 mins. Keep {eu65_flr}, {eu65_mlk}, and {eu65_but} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.

steps.title: Cook Golden & Finish with Glaze
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake at 375°F (190°C) or air-fry 14–16 mins (or fry 3 mins) until golden puffed, then fill or drizzle with {eu65_flv} and {eu65_sug}.
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or dust with sugar while still warm so the coating clings cleanly.

steps.title: Bake Bombolone & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 16 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Rest 5 Minutes & Serve Warm
steps.instructionTemplate: Carefully lift Bombolone out of the air-fryer basket and rest 5 minutes on a cooling rack so the crust crisps up. Plate into 6 servings and enjoy warm.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero-fluff steps + Cook Mode timer nailed it on the first batch!
